# R5.29 — Early offline examples and informative Lab lesson

## Summary

Lands the §7.2 **early offline examples and informative Lab
lesson** rows (ADR-0407). `crates/hharness/src/examples.rs` is
`hh-examples/1` — the checked runner over the landed owners:
`run_example(&mut EmbedService, &ExampleCard, …) →
Result<ExampleReport, ExampleError>` executes committed
`example-card/1` records on scratch stores and returns a
**semantic** report (never a process exit). Card decode is a
closed member set (`unsupported_shape` / `missing_field` /
`type_mismatch` / `unknown_case`); every declared `sha256:` pin
recomputes over the pinned file's actual bytes and drift refuses
`stale_pin` **before any execution**; separated build/runtime
costs, the honest `fixture_label`, prerequisites and limitations
are mandatory card members riding every report verbatim.

**EX-01** — `hello` → `open_session` on the pinned
`clients/ts/fixture-definition.json` → `submit{hh.submit}` →
attach **by the returned run id** → the six excerpts each resolve
to actual event id/seq/payload/causes (run/definition/submission;
the `model.call.*` → `action.effect.intended` `tool_call_id`
join; intended + `security.permission.decided`; the
authorized→prepared→committed→observed chain; `lifecycle.run.
finished` vs `verification.*`/`measurement.metric`;
`context.assembled` + `lifecycle.replay.*` markers) →
`kernel.bundle` → a **clean recipient** (fresh `EmbedService` on
a separate scratch store): `check_completeness` +
`kernel.reproduce` R0 `reproduced` — no producer fallback →
`decode_dir` + `admit_replay` (typed `CardRefused{missing_input}`
recorded verbatim as `expected_refusal` — the scripted lane mints
no `compiled_bundle`; tampered-copy `not_admitted` control).

**EX-02** — the informative two-task fixture (`ex-02-fixture/1`:
pinned grade table task1 A=1/5 B=4/5, task2 A=3/5 B=2/5 **plus
independently pinned `expected` counts**) → **one `run_recipe`
per task** (a shared per-cell grade vector would be the constant
fixture AC-2 refuses) → both `population-receipt/1` `closed` →
durable `measurement.metric.emitted` rows re-read through fresh
`Store`/`ResultsStore`/`LabDocs` handles (recipient-side rebuild)
→ the merged `ExperimentView` (the bound 20-slot universe fmc's
`tasks>=2` floor requires) → `analyze_and_record`
`finite_manifest_contrast` `beta{1,1}` → persisted
`analysis_report_body/1` (idempotent `report_id` re-serve) →
`DeclaredReceipt` + `recompute_analysis` → `reproduced`. Semantic
checks: `subjects_20`, `cells_pinned`, `informative_contrast`,
`report_identity`, `recipient_recompute`, `exploratory_label`
(`AnalysisStatus::Exploratory` — a configured sample/budget never
becomes a confirmation default), `refusal_controls` (bad lease /
missing row / duplicate settle verbatim).

- ADR-0407 (landing record), coverage dated note (seq 199), BL-47

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**2,564 changed source/test lines vs the ≤850 trigger (~3.0×) —
the new build high-water mark** (exceeds the prior ≤2.6×
envelope; band is precedent-not-limit, ~2.8–4.3× the packet
estimate is in-family) — recorded Deviation, accepted per the
scoped AMEND ruling `ff31b141`
(`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.29-split-review.md`):
adoption packet 3 OFFLINE binds EX-01/EX-02 as one owner unit
(no contingency — the packet writes contingencies verbatim where
intended, item 3 carries none); the documented family boundary
is OFFLINE(EX-01/02)-vs-EXAMPLES(EX-03/04) — named by AC-2
itself; the §7.2 EX-01/EX-02 row split is a real but
undocumented seam (the R5.26 documentary test); the shared
~578-line card surface + AC-1's conjunct spans the cut; every
proposed leg stays over the trigger even with ~340 spec/plan
lines relocated into pinned fixture JSON — non-curative.
